# RankMind AI

> RankMind AI is an SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform. Four agents — RankBot, LinkBot, GEO-G and ContentAI — audit websites, find relevant backlink prospects, prepare content for AI answer engines, and draft SEO content. You approve every outreach pitch and every publish.
> Researched and developed by Arabian AI Lab, Dubai.

## Agents
- RankBot: scores 10 technical SEO factors and gives a prioritised action plan.
- LinkBot: finds relevant sites, drafts outreach, and tracks responses. You approve every pitch.
- GEO-G: prepares content for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot and Claude. No ranking or citation is guaranteed.
- ContentAI: drafts SEO blog posts, landing pages and meta content. You approve before publishing.

## Pricing
- Starter: $29/month — 1 website, up to 20 keywords
- Growth: $79/month — 5 websites, LinkBot prospecting and outreach tracking
- Enterprise: $149/month — unlimited websites, GEO-G, ContentAI and priority support
